description: The plot illustrates the relationship between Co-occurrence Number and ACC (%) for five different models: Base, FT, IKE, MEND, and MEMIT. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" with a logarithmic scale, ranging from 0 to 10^3, with tick labels at 10^0, 10^1, 10^2, and 10^3. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" with a linear scale, ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The plot shows five lines representing the different models, each with distinct colors and marker shapes: Base (black, circle, solid) starts at around 38 at 3 co-occurrences and increases to 44 at 2000 co-occurrences; FT (blue, triangle down, solid) begins at 40 at 3 co-occurrences and rises to 48 at 2000 co-occurrences; IKE (red, triangle up, solid) starts at 44 at 3 co-occurrences and reaches 50 at 2000 co-occurrences; MEND (brown, diamond, solid) begins at 45 at 3 co-occurrences, increases to 51 at 30 co-occurrences, and further rises to 57 at 2000 co-occurrences; MEMIT (purple, square, solid) starts at 40 at 3 co-occurrences and increases to 55 at 2000 co-occurrences; and MEMIT (green, square, solid) begins at 51 at 3 co-occurrences and rises to 66 at 2000 co-occurrences. All lines exhibit an overall increasing trend as Co-occurrence Number increases.
